body: We booked the Madu River Safari with Buddhi in advance while we were still in the UK, and the whole process was straightforward and easy.On arrival, we were guided to a nearby car park and then walked about 50 metres to meet the team. After a short wait, our guide helped us onto the boat and made sure everyone had life jackets. From the start, everything felt well organised and relaxed.The experience itself was truly memorable. I had arranged the sunset tour, although my partner was initially a bit sceptical. However, as the journey unfolded, the beauty of the surroundings quickly changed that. With every passing minute, the scenery became more impressive.We passed fish farms, saw traditional prawn fishing methods, visited a cinnamon island, and stopped by a small temple along the way. Each part of the journey added something unique and gave a real insight into the local way of life.The highlight, without question, was the sunset. As the sun began to set, we reached what is known as “bird island”. Watching thousands of birds return to settle for the night was incredible. You could see them gliding low over the water, some lifting themselves slowly into the air before landing gracefully. We stayed and watched as the sky changed colour and the day came to a close.On the way back, we noticed small lantern lights across the prawn nets and even saw large bats beginning their night-time search for food. It added another layer to an already special experience.As a family of five, including two teenagers and a toddler, this was something we all genuinely enjoyed. It was calm, beautiful, and quite emotional at times. One of those experiences that reminds you how powerful and peaceful nature can be.A big thank you to Buddhi, Safiar, and the guide for making this so memorable. We also picked up some cinnamon oil and authentic cinnamon sticks to take home, which was a lovely bonus.Highly recommended if you are in the area.
title: A magical sunset safari, nature at its best

body: Scam Alert!!Paid 40,000LKR for a 7,000LKR ride. Tour guide and Boat operator Nexus.We were on trip covering Srilanka through a Tour operator and our tour operator provided us the cost for each activities on Day 1 itself. But the van driver assigned by the operator kept saying that the price we pay is high and he can arrange for them at lower price. I wanted to give a try and asked him to arrange for Madu river safari. He took us to No 7 Boat Safari and they offered two packages. One for $35 and another for $45 and they convinced us to take the second package for $45 which includes Fish spa and island visit. I felt the price was high, but its a brain fade moment. I didn't cross check the price with the operator price. Now comes the negotiation part. Our driver finally got the price to 40000LKR for 4 persons which is roughly around $34 per person. After reaching the Hotel, I checked the tour operator price. It's $22 per boat upto 6pax. Its 6,600LKR for the full boat whereas we have paid 40,000LKR. I called the driver to lobby and showed him the price quoted by his company and the price we paid. I told him, If I don't get my money back, I have to bring it to the notice of the tour manager. He then called someone and spoke in local language. After couple of minutes, he came back saying that the boat safari package through operator is $22 only but since we went there on our own, package rates were different and his friend has agreed to refund the amount and will transfer the money to his account. He also handed over 33,000LKR on the spot stating he will get it from his friend later.
title: Scam Alert!!

Going through a tunnel of Mangroves was the highlight for me ! And the “ thirst “quenching stop at a Juice Bar - where, after about 30 plus years I tasted our own “ Kirala” juice. ( Kirala a fruit that grows in this very area. ) There are the inhabited islands connected by small bridges. ( Thrilling to see a duo on a Motor bike pass atop us) and the historic temple, plus a little derelict shrine on the tiniest of Islands. ( Actually rock). To experience this ecological wonder and nature’s heritage that we are Blessed with. Hopefully! again and again.

body: Maduganga river safari at Betota is good to take experience, take boat ride of maduganga river & boat takes you through mangroves, thick forest. There are islands in the river & they take you to cinnamon island where locals demonstrate how cinnamon is extracted from tree. There is fish spa on this island which is another great experience, during safari you can hold baby crocodile. Good to go early morning to avoid sun heat which may be difficult for some. Overall good safari for around 1.5 hrs.
title: Maduganga river safari, different experience

body: very compact tour and worth it. you can try and skip the cinnamon route, as the fish spa and cinnamon are at the same place. you would be asked to pick 3 locations, so pick appropriately. we picked 3 and got to go around only 2 in practice.
title: Compact

body: 1.5 hour boat ride stopping at Cinnamon Island for a demo on how cinnamon sticks are made from the trees (including a drink of cinnamon tea), ventured through mangroves, saw bird life, a baby crocodile, held a baby purple face monkey and soaked our feet in the fish feeding farms. We all loved this cruise, very relaxing and best of all was the fish feeding off your feet. Didn't really hurt so much as tickled. A definitely Must Do.
title: Great Cruise

body: Madu river encircles nearly sixty four islands only six of these are inhibited. The safari which costs $35 a person for foreigner tourists is negotiable and comes down to even $20 other entry fees for Buddha island and fish spa included. The safari is interesting when it passes thru mangroves. At cinnamon island they provide educating info on the herb and fish spa is invigorating. Overall safari is worth the spend if negotiated intelligently.
title: Maduganga river safari

body: Madu river safari is a great 2-hour experience where we can feel the flora and fauna of Madu River. The safari starts with going under the mangroves roots, river creatures sightseeing which was a great experience. After that, we went to the cinnamon island where they showed you how cinnamon is extracted from the tree and how different products are made. Then, we went to fish feet massage point which was also good. Overall a good experience to have in Bentota
title: A great experience

body: We took a boat for a journey in the Madu river. It was exciting. The water was peaceful. Views at fish spa, cinnamon factory, fish farms and temple was great. The mangrove forest was also nice.
title: An enjoyable river cruise

body: This must do it really wonderful lake with lots of thinks to do fish spa , cinnamon usage and more of fun stuff
title: Amazing trip

body: This was an ok safari, you will get to see some 2-3 creatures like water monitor and a few birds. They then take you to a place where they show how to make cinnamon . You can do fish pedicure there. On the way someone can offer you to click picture with a baby crocodile for some money. If you do it in day time , take your sunglasses and scarf. The cost is too high for what they offer especially when you are solo or couple traveller. They also do not allow you to pool with other travellers unless you do it outside their premise. You can still bargain for the cost. But not the activity to spend 3-4 hrs for 5k bucks if you find more interesting things to do outside.
title: Not an activity for sunny Day

body: It was nice going in the boat for about one hour... going under the roots was an experience.. How they take bark was a knowledge..But never ever fall for the sales.. The powder has, may be 20% Cinnamon,rest some, bark powder... Don't buy it there.you can get good Cinnamon in any stores in Srilanka for a good price
title: Nice boat ride

body: It was an amazing experience at Madu River. We officially visited this place after our conference. We were assisted by Dear Shaan who made us so comfortable and we genuinely enjoyed the boat ride with open sky & you can see the nature, beauty, amazing ocean, beautiful birds, monkeys etc. Must visit place 😀😀😀
title: It was an amazing experience at Madu River. We officially visited this place after our conference.

body: This is a ‘must do’ while In Sri Lanka. A beautiful peaceful sail with very interesting stops en route. Well worth the drive and with an exceptionally good guide. A fabulous day out!
title: Fab trip!

body: We were so lucky to arrange our boat ride with a recommended boat service calledMadu River Buddhi Boat Safari in Balapitiya. We booked our tour online after sending a FB message to their site. Received a swift reply and the day we went there, they were all ready to welcome us.Boat ride through the mangroves was amazing. Our guide was very informative and explained everything to us. It was a service that comes with the boat hire. We were lucky to sight a variety of birds and a few other animals. They took us to a beautiful Buddhist temple, and we got a chance to hand-feed a Sri Lankan giant squirrel. Also, the owner of the service had a pet monkey called ''Kiriya'', and we were given the opportunity to cuddle and feed him.During the boat ride, we visited a fish therapy place (pricing not included in the boat tour) and also an island called Cinnamon island, where we experienced the process of extracting cinnamon. We bought some fresh cinnamon (price for buying cinnamon is not included in your boat ride price) and were treated with free cinnamon tea as well.Overall it was a well planned and a hassle-free tour. After the boat ride, they offered us fresh king coconut, free of charge. It was a great way to end the journey. They charged us a very reasonable price for all this.I highly recommend them for their friendly service.
title: Best service ever!

body: My partner and I escaped to Madu river for some alone time. It's basic living if your up for it. We took supplies for self catering and jumped into the car travelling from Colombo. It takes about 1hr and 30 minutes to arrive at the land called Majorie. The cabin is built from shipping pallets and has a fan with running water. The temperature is around 28C so no hot water is needed for the shower. The shower is refreshing and I have the birds eye view of nature as I shower. It then follows that we have to find wood for burning later on for the camp fire.At the meal time I prepare the food after getting the fire started. I brought a steamer with me for easy cooking and placed on top of the fire. 20 minutes later fish and veg cook. I then mixed it in to a sauce I had made and served with spaghetti. And then we sung some songs around the camp fire drinking a few lion beers. Sleeping at night is really cool as the sounds of the nature are clear and relaxing. The air is cool and so no need for the fan. Great time and we have returned many times since
title: Sweet nature and so peaceful

body: Its good to visit it once - the program is absolutely similar for every river boat trip in Sri Lanka - 1) mangrove forest - perfect impressions 2) fish massage - not everyone would like it 3) temple's island - looks more "commercial project" rather than temple, but good for fun 4-5) oil island and cinnamon island - we didn't visit it, because thats just the way to sell you either oil or cinnamon You should definitely visit some of those proposed river trips, because the adventure is interesting enough if you have time and especially if you're passing the river over, if you would be suggested to pass significant way to visit such a trip - don't waste time
title: Too commercial, meanwhile authentic

body: Superb Safari!We were taken to the Maadu River bio diversity area by Sam our Guide.We used Jaliya Boat Service with Roshan, an active and knowledgeable boat driver at the helm.Great experience around 64 islands, mangrove forests, visiting a Cinnamon hand processing centre, Hindu Temple, Buddha Statue, Cobra Snake Island, Bird Island, etc.The river, birds, animals, dense vegetation made for a surreal experience. SL Rupees 5000 for the safari included a wonderful surprise of a fish spa pedicure!The Maadu River boat Safari supports the islanders by giving many a livelihood.Hughly recommended!A.W Jaliya Arnold Tel: 071-2976812 Mobile
title: Jaliya Boat Service, Maadu River Safari

body: A feel of freedom and wilderness on this ride on the river waters through swamping forests. Beautiful to see locals living their everyday lives, including fishing and taking goods to market on the natural waterways.
title: Exotic boat ride & scenery

body: We paid 5000 LKR(one boat 4 adult and one child)for boat safari at maadu river Sri-Lanka. You need to negotiate as different people quote different price. Price is for one boat not for number of people.
title: Maadu river Boat safari

body: i always enjoy going along on this river by the boat, many island and i love the smallest island which is in the middle of the river. fish therapy spots,, and small cool spot on the middle of the river is fascinating, you could tast a king coconut while you are on the boat, visiting to the little house wher you could see how they make cinnamon skin dry. and there is a temple you could visit.
title: i have been on this boat trip many times and i always enjoying a lot when ever i go along that rive,,

body: We paid 9000 LKR for the two of us, which was definitely not worth the boat trip (this was not a ‘river safari’) which lasted just over 1 hour. We did see some wildlife (1 monitor and some cormorant birds) but not worth it. We stopped off at cinnamon island which was interesting but in the overall scheme of things I’d give this expensive boat trip a miss and put your money towards an amazing actual safari in one of the national parks where you will be sure to see a lot of wildlife. Don’t waste your money on this.
title: Not recommended

body: This is the best boat service in balapitiya Highly recommended, this company. We enjoyed a lot.......
title: Best service

title: Madu ganga biodiversity area

body: Madhu Ganaga river is starting from Galle district and and in Balapitiya it is widening and formed as a Lake. Here tourists underetook boat ride. This river from the lake again flowing and joining Indian ocean. It is one of the tourist attraction.
title: Madu river

body: We had an experience of Boat Ride in Madhu Ganga River for an hour through Mangrove Boat. Boat go through mangrove marshes and through dark forest. In the middle of the tour, we had fish massage and took break and drank coconut water. We all wore life jacket and enjoyed the ride.
title: Madhu ganga Boat ride

body: A boat ride on Mary Ganga is a good experience. The river has number of islands. Boat safari includes stopping at islands inside the logoon for a temple visit, visit to cinaman garden for a demo of how cinaman is extracted. Also there is a fish massage halt. Can site a crocodile too and ofcourse lot of bird species and the monitor lizard.

body: Madu River boat Safari - BalapitiyaThe whole cruise of 1.5hrs takes you on a boat safari through the primitive depths of the mangrove marshes in Madu RiverWe paid LKR 6000 for a boat for two. we advised to negotiate the price starting from LKR 3500 for the entire boat.Try Fish foot massage provides by the Madu Ganga fish spas, is a memorable experience which shouldn't be missed.We paid LKR 400 per person for 15 minutes.Learn how to produce cinnamon sticks at cinnamon island and see al sorts of exotic birds. Don't forget to try cinnamon Tea...Cheers & Enjoy
title: Madu Ganga Boat Safari for something different

body: We were advised to visit the madu river by our tour guide Assanka Samarajeewa who took us on a great ride with Captain boat rides safari. We got to visit cinnamon island and see al sorts of animals like monitors, flying fish and exotic birds. The tour is about an hour and a half and is really nice to try. If you wanna do something different and explore islands at the same time then book the river safari tour
title: Fun

body: A nice relaxing boat ride but nothing spectacular. Cinnamon Island was ok as was the temple. The boat driver was informative and friendly but didn’t speak much English so we were lucky we had a Sri Lankan with us.
title: Pleasant Enough

body: Most resorts in Balapitiya area has the luxury of great views of Madu river .Boat rides, fish spas are among customer favorites. It’s very breathtaking to experience the boat ride among various trees and plants towards the river bank and vignettes beautiful birds around.Beautiful piece of nature
title: Very relaxed

body: You see mangroves, mangroves caves, bats and waranes. Tour is too long and too boring. Also the cost is too expensive
title: Not worth it

body: Madu river is located in balapitiya in southern it’s a nice place to visit when you straight to down south beach side. There are many boat services and it costs around Rs.3000-3500 per one boat. You can experienced in fish theraphy and able to study the cinnamon industry and have very scenic view of bio diversified environment. Boat rides take usually around 1 and half hour. Definitely it’s worth journey.
title: Nice boat ride

body: Awesome experience - a must do if your staying at the Riverhouse by Asia Leisure. They have their own boat and driver and guide.
title: Spectacular Boat trip

body: It was a wonderful experience in the river. No words to explain, just amazing. Little islands, open air fish massage, everything wonderful.
title: Amazing experience

body: It has been a long term desire , and by chance we made it to this beautiful River with my family and relatives. Had an adventurous great tour around the River . There were incredibly blue jellyfish too !! It’s a must trip , many fish massage available too !!! Do visit Madu River !!
title: A dream come true

body: This June 2019 was the 2nd time in 6 months we had this adventure! It was really a nice excursion in the river. Boat company scheduled to stopped on 3 islands i.e. Cinnamon, Buddhist Temple and Fish Farm but since we said no to Fish Farm so we stopped on other 2 islands. During Jan 2019 my husband & I had the tour, this time we took 2 of my sisters along with us.We choose the same boat company we choose during Jan 2019 tour. The same company in 6 months increased the Boat tour from Rs.5000 to Rs.8000 straight away forgetting we had 6 months ago for Rs.5000. When we refused and complained of their unreasonable increase then agreed to charge Rs.5000!
title: Great experience in the river

body: The boat spacious though the ride was a bit expensive. However, the good thing was that the staff didn't hurry up or hasten the entire journey. We saw jellyfish, kingfisher, backwaters of the country, cinnamon island where they grow cinnamon trees and convert the products into various forms - oils, powder etc.Take 2 hrs to enjoy the complete journey. Is economical if there is a family of 3-4 people travelling.And yes, they do provide life-saving swimming jackets strapped around your chest. Do wear it, if you want to enjoy a tension-free time here.
title: Boat Ride with lots of space...! If you're lucky, you will get to see rare species.

body: Very interesting tour of this river, didnt think it was worth it but afterwards very happy we chose to do it.
title: A must do while here

body: Madu River or Madu Ganga as it is commonly called here in Lanka is definitely one of d beautiful experiences of the country..The backwaters give u an adventurous kind a feeling and to experience the adventure on waters, u need a boat.To surf through the backwaters, we hired a 12 seater boat from Mangroves cave resort, which we got for LKR 6000. U need not worry about sunlight much since every boat has a overhead cover.Its a 2-2.5 hours journey altogether.You get to sail through the mangroves , with the mangroves trees both sides and hovering above you.You get a feeling like u are going in a Amazon river.It was the most instagrammable place and one of d amazing part of d boat ride..U sail below the bridges and since they are so close to water u have to bend your head down while the boat passes beneath it to avoid banging ur head.There are three places where boat takes a halt.First one is d cinnamon island where an old man shows his art of making cinnamon and serves u hot cinnamon tea..He was nice and a hospitable person and u may buy some cinnamon items if u want .Second one is d Buddhist temple , where Lord Buddha abodes, nestled in one of d island in d river.Third one is s fish spa..it was a nice experience where the fishes tickles ur feet, biting ur dead skin cells off it.This u can do for LKR 200 pp.U can also enjoy d king coconut water from one of d shops bang in the middle of d river..airport wonder how he commutes there everyday.The last stop is the delta where the river meets d sea. It was a very pleasant sight. And after this we return back to the resort.In this ride u enjoy d greenery and scenery all throughout and the nice breeze keeps u soothed..
title: Amazing backwaters of Sri Lanka

body: We took this boat ride through our host agent Serendib Roots and it was one of the greatest experiences we could have during our tour. The area and the surrounding environment was very peaceful and serene. We would definitely visit this place and take a ride again in this beautiful Madu River.
title: Amazing boat ride.

body: Excellent place. All the stoppage like cinnamon factory , Fish Spa and Sailing through Mangrove are amazing experience. If this boating is not part of package, browse to see prices for the season and book accordingly.
title: Madu River : Must do Activity

body: Best boat ride ever! The cinnamon village was a unique experience. prices were reasonable as well. We will visit again when we come back! :)
title: Amazing view of Madu River

body: Loads of different boat companies. Our driver recommended Captains Boat House & it was great. 3000 each for private boat & friendly excellent English speaking guide. Showed us many birds/ cattle/ water monitors/ lizards/ fish. Interesting visit to Cinnamon Island. Made me necklace from water lily. Stopped for King Coconut too. Could see other boat companies with loads of crammed in passengers & shabby boats. If doing this river safari look for Captains Boat House.
title: Captains Best

body: When you travel down south Sri Lanka, you can spend lot of time in Bentota, Kosgoda and also Induruwa beaches. But don't forget to have, Madhu river boat safari, It's very interesting and rare opportunity to have a experience like that. The boat safari cost will be around Rs. 3000.00.
title: Boat Safari in Madhu river

body: Amazing place to visit. For me Madhuwa island located in Madhu river is very interesting.In this island 180families live calm fully. The size of the island is 200 aces. Cinnamon in their main income, besides fishing and boat transportation.
title: Excellent place who love to see and learn about Bio-Diversity

body: Recommend all the nature lovers to do river safari at Madu River. The boat ride takes you through the mangroves and to the Cinnamon island and to Fish spa. We did Fish spa and was a tingling experience. Got lot of Cinnamon from the Cinnamon Island as they explain how Cinnamon bark is massaged and removed form the Branch of the tree. Very Interesting it was. Even got to taste fresh Cinnamon Tea which was so refreshing and energizing.
title: loved the river safari

body: Was a pleasant hour and a half with some fun stops but over priced at lkr 3000 per person. Next time I would negotiate a little harder. Lkr 1000 per person would be all you should pay particularly because there are tons to be paid as well.
title: Ok to do but is overpricred

body: This river safari was planned instantly and it was a good one. An hour drive in the river, watching various birds, meeting the family who makes cinnamon sticks, doing fish spa, Budda temple in the river, visiting one of the oldest temple in the river, while the sun was setting made the whole experience awesome.
title: Awesome river safari

body: Nice tour. We saw baby crocodiles. And we went to the temple in middle of the river island. It was really amazing.
title: Beautiful river

body: I was a 1.5 hours long boat safari across the Madu river surrounded by lush Mangrove forest. We went inside mangrove caves, saw some Salamander on our way. Our Boat driver was quite nice and he made sure we spend ample time at each points. Overall a good experience.
title: Lovely boat safari

body: Foreigners and locals customers alike, were many. We were served by a waiter named Lakshitha. Despite a full restaurant and many orders, he was patient and very attentive to our order at the same time, being courteous. This was absolute proper service which many other restaurants should follow. The soups and food we ordered came warm and fresh. The club sandwich was better than any we've had in Colombo. And other portions were ample too. Washrooms were well maintained and clean. All in all, a great place to come for a meal. Well done Mangrove Cave. We will be coming again for sure!
title: A great place to have a good meal for a reasonable price

body: The Madu Ganga is a minor watercourse which originates near Uragasmanhandiya in the Galle District of Sri Lanka, before widening into the Madu Ganga Lake at Balapitiya. The river then flows for a further a 4.4 km (2.7 mi) before draining into the Indian Ocean.
title: Madu river

body: Several boat operators are based on the Madu River and offer varying length cruises u the river. The boat ride is relaxing as you pass mangroves, fish spas, locals fishing from their boats, fish traps a floating fruit juice stall and have bird and wild life pointed out. We saw two water monitors, a beautiful bright blue kingfisher and family of monkeys.Our cruise destination was Kurundu Doowa (Cinnamon Island). At the island we were shown how they peel the cinnamon bark from certain sized branches to form the curled sticks. We tried some cinnamon tea and were shown other cinnamon products. Ceylon cinnamon is considered the best in the world.The cruise has more opportunities than was presented to us and a good tourist operator would develop it.
title: Cruise to Kurundu Doowa (Cinnamon Island)

body: Not much to do, you get on boats, try to see some birds or lizards hanging around, stop by for a coconut 🥥 drink & see how they capture shrimp in an elaborate wooden chute that’s lit on one end at night to attract them.Just the experience of being in one of Sri Lanka’s rivers & provide a tourist activity to meander.
title: Nothing exciting:)

body: we were explore the madu river in February. It was a really really nice safari. The guide and the boatman both were super knowledgeable around the area. The best thing was they took us to a fish massage centre on the riverbank. It was a super cool experience which I haven't had before. had a great relaxation during the massage. we were lucky to see the local traditional fishing events in the river, using traditional boats. saw several birds, the guide knew exactly where to look for the birds.
title: had a fish massage. superb

body: This was part of a day trip and gave an insight into the river. It is advertised as a river safari but that is an exaggeration. We saw jelly fish and toured the mangroves. We visited a Cinnamon Island and monastery and opted not to have the fish massage.
title: An average excursion

body: We got into a boat. The boat driver pointed out "eagle there" far out in the distance. Pointed out "jelly fish there" and that was the extend of explanations. We were dropped off at Cinnamon Island, walked 10 steps to a hut where a lady demonstrated the peeling of the bark and how it dried. And a bit of selling. Took a whole 10 minutes and we were back on the boat.We cruised around some mangrove swamps, pointed out "Buddhist temple", "island", "smallest island" and that was the end of the boat ride.My guide "recommended" we give the boat driver a tip of R500. It was over in less than an hour.
title: What a farce

body: We toured Madu River because we had time before our flight and wanted to visit a small-scale cinnamon plantation and producer. The boat ride was pleasant, passing through mangroves, fish spas, prawn farming, floating juice stalls and temples. The cinnamon tour was short and simple yet informative. We bought some of their products because we trusted them and they were reasonably priced. They were referred to by our local guide so based on other reviews, maybe there are other plantations or producers who might not be so genuine. We paid a costly 4,500 Rs. for the boat ride even though we only made one stop.
title: Cinnamon Plantation

body: we had this attraction as a part of package tour in srilanka.15 km from our bentota hotel.busy with tourist.nice ride for app 1 hour(couple-pvt tour).deep river at some point but jacket provided.old boat but we think it was safe with 1 person operating/explaining.some point of interest. you may get down to buy spices/fish foot massage/but we did not.small old hindu temple in the river .nice view through bushes/worth it if you like boat rides.
title: SRILANKA VISIT-FEB2019

body: This was not among our planned activities to do. We went to Turtle preservation project but were highly disappointed to see the sorry state of the hatchery and exorbitant prices. We decided not to go there and then our guide suggested we should take a river safari in Madu river.There are a bunch of agencies which provide the safari. You can choose any one of them as all of them take the same route. Some have better boats than other. We chose the cheapest one and paid 4500 LKR for 5 people. They also allowed our guide to board the boat (I don't know if they had a special arrangement with him).It was a 1 hour 30 minutes ride during which we had a fish massage and a visit to Cinnamon tea farm. We did not go to the temple and just checked it out from our boat. FIsh massage was pretty good. It's not expensive even though it's in the middle of the river. The fishes were quite big as compared to the fishes in the fish tank at other places that offer fish massage. At tea farm, we were offered freshly brewed cinnamon tea which was quite good. We did not buy anything from there, when asked we respectfully refused.We saw a lot of different and beautiful birds during our ride. Also checked the local life alongside river. Talked to vendors who were selling their stuff in the middle of the river on a wooden platform.Overall, a good experience. The river was pretty dirty though and could definitely use some preservation.
title: Not bad. We enjoyed it despite all the pollution in the river

body: Suitable for early morning or evening. Need to bargain as they quote different rates. Life jackets provided.Fish spa pond is good.They try to sell local cinnamon oil.One can go for this trip but avoid trip white stone gem factories. Thats a waste of time. better to spend that time In Galle
title: Madu River

body: This river cruise has a lot of experiences for the entire family. Dont miss the fish massage therapy experience. Kids loved it, was the highlight of the cruise and the trip to Bentota.
title: Great experience with the river cruise

body: Organising this trip was so easy, the support staff(Lalees a) were very helpful. And the tour was superb, the guide was so informative and friendly.We got to see loads of different amimals and even Got to Hold a baby monkey.Great day
title: Kind, friendly, informative, helpful

body: This was our one and only disappointing experience in Sri Lanka. We accepted the rather high charge (3500RP) as there were just two of us in the boat, but there was no reduction for reducing the duration from 1.5 to 1 hour as we didn't want to see another temple. The boat was very old and run-down. My wife injured herself getting in by tripping and landing on a broken seat. We pressed on. First we stopped by a man holding a monkey wanting money for a photo and we declined. Then on to a fish spa where they nibble at your feet - again we declined. Finally to a very basic demonstration of how cinnamon is harvested - again we didn't buy. Every stop is aimed at getting more money out of you and what wildlife did we see? The sum total was two cormorants. A very depressing rip-off!--
title: One to avoid!

body: The evening spent in a boat ride , where we experienced the Fish Therapy, Marshy Lagoons and the "Kirala Juice from the floating shop. Paid only SLR 4,000 for a two hour ride and it is excellent journey.
title: Experience the Sun Set while boat riding in Maadu Ganga

body: We went on a 'safari' with an outfit called No 07. It was the most dispiriting thing we did on the island. For 3500 rupees you get an hour in a knackered old boat with a noisy engine and a guide who has learnt a few English expressions, and all under the hot sun. You get to see a couple of birds, some mangrove roots, a poor woman showing you how cinnamon sticks are produced and the opportunity to have your feet nibbled. Avoid
title: Worst experience in Sri Lanka!

body: To pay USD40 for 90 minutes of speedboating in a sea-like river is not my idea of fun. A similar ride off the Andamans in Bay of Bengal is more interesting and far less expensive. Here, they take you to cinnamon island where you watch you sip cinnamon tea while watching how cinnamon is processed from trees. At the end of it all you are expected to buy the product at several times the market price. You also get to see a very small Hindu temple on a slightly bigger rock island. Then you are taken to another island dedicated to Buddhism. Finally, the fish spa where you dangle you legs in water to let the fish feed on your dead skin. You pay SLR200 for the privilege.
title: An expensive boat ride on a sea like river

body: An hour and half on the lagoon was a pleasant experience, but there are loads of boats and no wildlife to see. The Buddhist temple was worth a visit as was cinnamon island. Although you don’t see anything of the island. It is a demonstration of how cinnamon is harvested and a small sip of cinnamon tea. Then buy a few cinnamon products which is fair enough. It’s an OK trip but at £20 per couple not cheap for Sri Lanka, and that was after some bartering.
title: Enjoyable but very touristic and expensive

body: This really is so much fun, the Mandu River Tour really teaches so much about nature in the mangroves, once you are on the boat you are off, Lizards, Eagles, Kingfishers, Monkeys, and even jelly fishes are a part is this great excursion. We even stopped off at the fish foot massage, I have never laughed so much. We really would of not missed this tour, you are immersed by incredle nature and to experience such serenity is a joy! A must if you are in the area!
title: Totally awesome experience, an oasis of nature!

body: I've already reviewed the mangrove experience as an activity but the company itself is completely unethical, and the boats are not safe and disrupt the ecological balance. If you want a lovely mangrove boat tour, I've reviewed one in Kalpitiya which was absolutely lovely (and there are several companies that seem to be equally good operating in Kalpitiya). Avoid Balapitiya and read others' reviews about this company.
title: Disgusting scam

body: We have been on river cruises everywhere ... Bangkok Damnoen Saduk market, Philippines, Paris on the Seine, on the HuangPu in Shanghai, etc. This is not interesting at all. Mangrove swamps - yes, seen them all over SE Asia swampy lands. Fish spas - been there, done that in many places in AsiaJust a ride in a speed boat (noisy & smelly gasoline) along Madu River, stopping at Cinnamon island where they try to sell you cinnamon bark, cinnamon powder or cinnamon oil. No thank you. Just a ride, no explanation or introduction of anything.And some guy with a baby monkey comes to ur boat and hands u the monkey to take photos. Most likely taken the monkey away from its mother. No thanks!Waste of time and money.
title: Don't bother

body: An excellent 90 mins boat ride through the river and backwaters of Madu river is worth experiencing. In the 90 min ride, have a stop at Sinnamon island, Buddhist temple island and experience the Fish spa therapy. Cost is $35(USD) per person and a must visit place. Location: around Bentota area (approx 80 km south of Colombo on Galle Road)
title: Madu river ride : a memorable experience

body: This is a popular boat safari where one can see beautiful mangroves,though birds are not many.The price is quite excessive considering the duration of lthe ride.Still there were large number of boats and tourists thronging the place.Worth one ride anyway.
title: good safari

body: Basically an hour plus long boat ride with barely any wild life (a couple of birds), and a couple of distinct tourist trap type places. A cinnamon island where they peddle cinnamon for you to buy, a fish massage pond, a temple where a monk is shamelessly pressuring for donations. Other than being boring and a waste of money, there's a real feel of being treated as a walking wallet. The whole operation is unpleasant and best to be avoided.
title: Total waste of time and money

body: Good tropical " river " experience. Lot of boat services. Know few things before u board. Few temples and islands to see including cinnamon manufacturers.
title: Good tropical " river " experience.

body: We have to thank Mendis for being our excellent host on our Madu River Safari which we did early one morning. It was a lovely tranquil trip with the chance to see lots of colourful birds herons and various kinds of Kingfisher. I’m amazed how the birds are not nervous of humans being so fixated on fishing. He knows the places to find them and we think he must have bionic eyes to spot for us. We saw a very relaxed monkey, and I’d never seen a sloth before. In fact loads of different wildlife in this area. We visited an amazing temple and we are now cinnamon converts to see off the mosquitoes as well as other remedies. A very enjoyable trip.
title: Early morning delight

body: Oh dear. It was billed as a wonderful wildlife experience but wonderfully underwhelming. We donned life vests and took off ducking under bridges (oh what fun. not) searching for anything remotely looking like wildlife. We didn't want to stop and have fish feed on our dead skin or visit a cinnamon plantation or pagodas - we have seen enough of these, so we just cruised flat out near the mangroves. We saw 2 birds. If you haven't cruised a river at high speed before then you might enjoy it more than we did.
title: There's 90 minutes I won't get back

body: It is very good , to don’t mis. It is close to Bentota . There are lot of places where to find a boat tour . An excellent experience.
title: Madr Ganga River Safari

body: We took a boat safari through our driver recommendation. Overall it was a good experience...the river could be maintained better. The best part of it is seeing a baby crocodile from local fisherman and cinnamon trees.
title: Baby crocodile 🐊

body: its a 2to 3 hrs boat ride along the mangroves.lots of birds can be seen.visit to an island for fish spa and spice garden is there on the way.
title: serene

body: This ride cost us SLK 4500, Which was much cheaper then most river safari s cost.Most companies charge SLK5000.They is some things to see, Crocodiles maybe one, and bats and green snakes.Our guide was very nice and knowledgeable about the mangrove.It was indeed a lovely experience
title: Boat Services

body: We took a 90 minute boat ride with No. 07 Madu River Boat Safari. It was great. First we saw a range of floating shops and fish farms, then we visited a cinnamon company where we enjoyed complimentary cinnamon tea, next was a fish spa and finally we travelled to the delta. The scenery was pretty.
title: Relaxing and interesting

body: Boat ride on Madu river is a must in Sri Lanka. The beautiful Mangrove plantations take your breath away
title: Amazing Nature!!!

body: Its a memorable river safari,amazing mangroves can see during boat ride then fish massage. Also cinnamon island is there, u think must see attractions.
title: River safari

body: Madu River Safari takes you to a different world of experience. You are given dedicated boats and will be given pit stop for fish spa and then some more long drives under the bridge and finally they take you along the path where this river meets the ocean . Me and my husband enjoyed this experience a lot.
title: Enjoyed to bits

body: We enjoyed our Madu river safari greatly. Beautiful nature, lots of interesting places to visit. Spotted some really beautiful birds and enjoyed a lot our time in these pleasant wetlands!
title: Great Trip, Very Beautiful Nature

body: First experience, haggle for a price. Don't pay anything they ask for. We paid 6400lkr for a boat of our own. Initially we went to a vendor who asked 13000lkr for the same, but luckily we didn't choose him. There are many vendors so you can find a cheaper price than what we also paid.Secondly, look out for weather. Don't try doing it when it's sunny. You will ruin the experience. The experience was more or less same as other reviews. Cinnamon guy will expect tip at later stage so better buy something from him. He sells cinnamon stick, powder or oil, any one at 300lkr each. We also saw a big monitor lizard on that island too from a very near distance. The actual fun was fish spa. Very ticklish initially .But not suggested for very young kids and people with delicate skin though.
title: Pretty decent

body: Just going arround with a boat at river too expensive for what it offers nothing to see there just saw 2 kind of birds!!
title: Too expensive

body: We took a 'safari' in a boat. This was expensive, uninformative and rammed with people. There were far too many boats, so every point of interest was a fracas. The guide had no knowledge or seeming interest in the surroundings. The birds and wildlife we had seen on simar trips were absent, possibly due to the excessive number of people.
title: Overvisited, strangely lacking in wildlife

body: We did the cruise about 9am so it was lovely and quiet. We saw several eagles, 1 monkey, 1 crocodile (apparently this is very rare), egret and a kingfisher. The boat trip is relaxed and friendly. We stopped at an island to watch cinnamon making, which was enjoyable and informative ... there is an expectation you will buy something but this was fine as things were cheap and the people clearly had no money and earned a living this way.
title: River cruise

body: It was a nice trip organised by a Bord'eau restaurant. We have seen a lot of the backwaters of Madu river, mangroves are fascinating and aldo seeing how cinnamon is produced out of a cinnamon tree. Small budhist temple is worth a visit. The nly problem is that in high seson there are a lot of boats full of tourist on the river....
title: Boat trip on Madu river

body: It was ok but not great at all. I thought it would be better. They just take u in a boat first for fish foot massage then to show u cinnamon and if u want to buy. For me it wasn’t excellent plus I have been to a spice garden and bought cinnamon so this wasn’t great but ok. I feel the price little high. The driver told me to pay $25 but I paid 4000 LKR which little less than $25 but still high.I don’t really recommend this trip
title: Was ok but not great

body: We have just paid 44 euros (R8,800) for my husband and I to be raced around on the water seeing close to nothing in terms of nature. What is a wonderful estuary with fantastic mangrove forests is being abused by these motor boats screeching around just wanting to stop at the money making points along the way. We saw one kingfisher, a few fish eagles, one cormorant and a water monitor. We declined numerous of the stops (only did cinnamon island) and it was all over in just over an hour. Please don't waste your money and time on this trip.
title: What a rip off - pure abuse

body: Its cost is very high to activities. Its like renting a boat for an hour in the river. U only visit the cinnamon island and see how is it done (and u can pay to but) and if u like fish massage (which also u will pay for). Thats all and really not worth unless u want to.PS. It cost 55$ for a private boat
title: Not worth and high cost. Its almost like renting a boat in river for an hour

body: Need to book the boat to go to the cinnamon island. You can get fresh cinnamon and also view the process of how cinnamon is made.
title: Cinnamon island

body: We had nice river safari !! really enjoyed the mesmerizing views we saw and i had a great photography over there , Nice kingfisher photos i had taken ,land monitor lizard , Black monkey , little green bee eater . Overall nice experience.
title: MADU RIver boat Safari

body: Went on this excursion and was pleased to see a water monitor soon after setting off. After that, all we saw were a few kingfishers and cormorants. A visit to Cinnamon Island was a selling opportunity and a very cheeky stop at a tank containing many fish was revealed to be a money taking stop again. Some guy with a young monkey appeared ( no doubt wanting money too ) but we quickly declined. 90 mins and £30 for 2 wasted.
title: Don`t waste your money.

body: This costs USD25 per person for a two hour ride through the Madu river islands. take binoculars for the birds and water monitors - there are fish farms, mangrove swamps, many other interesting trees and plants, shops on stilts, temples - some of which you can stop at. Its good value. But this is Sri Lanka - so you will probably get a small boat sidling up to you and a baby monkey suddenly thrust into your arms for a photo and some rupees; in a temple we stopped at we were immediately accosted by a would be guide - but our boatman was a perfectly good one. However in a small museum sat a monk who pointed out some treasures, wrapped some string round our wrists and chanted a mantra of good luck - and then asked us to sign a visitors book with a column for "donation". al visitors giving more than R1000! Its hard to say no. The best stop was at "Cinnamon Island" where what seems a very primitive setup explains the production of cinnamon oil and cinnamon sticks. You are given a cup of cinnamon tea (very good), and can buy small bottle of oil (R400) or sticks.
title: Delightful Boat ride - but watch for the extras!

body: The place is touristic so be sure that you get help to find a good local boat guide. Be aware that the prices vary a lot. The demonstration at the Cinnamon Island was quite interesting. The visit to the Buddha Tempel was also nice although the price for the ”donation” is quite high. Take a picture in the mangrove tunnels also.
title: Be sure that you get a good boatdriver/guide

body: Charging 4500LKR per person.... Taking advantage of foreigners..pls don't get cheated.... Read all reviews before visiting
title: Money looters

body: If you have money and nothing to do just go there jump in the boat and go around and see nothing :) only fish place was nice we pay 40 USD spend your money for something else Sri Lanka is expensive place but this trip was waste of time and money
title: Don't go

body: We wanted to show our 2 year old son crocodiles and monkeys in their natural habitat but instead we found ourselves paying far too much money going by motor boat passed floating shops with comercial ads for coca cola and similar. We asked the boat driver if he though we would see any monkeys he shrugged. A short time later he stopped by a house by the lake and a man came out of the house with an monkey in his hands. Terrible. A good thing with the trip however was the stop at Cinnamon Island. That was intreresting to see.
title: Tourist trap and unethical treatment of animals

body: This trip is a must if you are in the area. Go to the Captains Boatyard for the evening cruise. We went in the rain which was extremely atmospheric and saw the most wonderful bird life and huge fruit bats. Watch the fishermen light the lanterns at dusk to catch the fresh water shrimp. Stop at Cinnamon Island to see how they make cinnamon sticks and look out for crocodiles in the mangrove tunnels.
title: Excellent Wildlife

body: This experience is a sad example of unrestricted tourism development and its impact on the environment. Literally hundred of powerboats Cruise this river now and it’s surprising any wildlife remains to be seen. We did see some black monkeys, a crocodile, and two comerants but it was the off season. It is overpriced and I would not recommend to others. The lagoon closer to Hikkaduwa has a tour on paddle powered catamarans that is much more eco friendly and a more enjoyable experience.
title: Eco unfriendly tour

body: We had around two hours boat tour visiting a variety of wildlife, little islands and some activities. Fish spa is a wonderful experience and there is a Buddhist temple in one of the island.
title: Nice boat experience

body: not the most enigmatic of things to do... safety on the boats are not that great.... but if you are in to nature and fresh water marine life.. this place is heavenly... many crocs in the area.. a visit to the cinnamon island was a real treat.
title: a unique experience

body: We went on our boat ride in the middle of the day (not our choice but the tour guide's), so perhaps this was the reason why we saw almost no wildlife on our tour; however, this may also be the reason why we had the lake practically all to ourselves. The boats had covers that could be pulled up and down over you, so no worries if it rained or if it were too sunny. Our guide took us through the mangroves to a small Buddhist temple and pointed out the prawn farming sites and a small Hindu temple in the middle of the lake. But he didn't even mention the Cinammon island until I insisted that we go there. Once we were there, we were treated to some cinammon tea and a short demonstration about how cinammon sticks and oil were made (FYI the cinammon oil is a bit more expensive than at the airport). Personally, I enjoyed this demonstration and didn't find the people too pushy about tipping unlike many other tourist spots in Sri Lanka. Our guide was keen to show us some shops on stilts in the lake where we could buy some food and drinks but didn't push when we said we were fine. We loved the fish spa and especially the pool with the big fish in them because that was a bit unusual (cost was 200 Rupees a person at the one I had gone to next to Cinammon island). Our guide though didn't take us to see a couple of other sites I saw posted on his company's poster (a bridge, Snake Island and another island)- perhaps he only wanted to work his 1 hour and a half and not a minute more. Go if you'd like to have these kinds of different experiences - it's yet another tourist attraction to see if you happen to be in the area.
title: Don't go in the middle of the day

body: We went there with family. We paid 100$ for 2 adult and 1 kid, second kid was free as he is too young. They provide with a bottle of chilled water each. During the safari you get chance to hold the monkey, roll the cinnamon stick and put your feet in the tank with fish. Overall a fun experience for family.
title: Exploring the river

body: We were told that it would be around 9$ per person but when we reached at the place we were asked to pay 20$ per person. We tried to negotiate but it did not help. Since we had travelled till there we paid 20$ per person. If you travelling through an agency please get it confirmed about the rates. If you travelling on your own please beware of such incident and get it clarified before going.
title: Beware

body: One of the best trips in Sri Lanka, we hired a boat and guide for about 1700 and took our own time to stop at all places including the temple and the Cinnamon island. The guide was very experienced and we saw so many varieties of birds, king fishers, monkeys, many water monitors, prawn fisheries. The boat was great as it had a shade which you could put up anytime. It was a fantastic family experience and kids thoroughly enjoyed it. Highly recommended!
title: An amazing relaxing time with kids

body: A nice boat trip amongst the mangroves where you can see some nice birds, trees and nature and experience the wind in your hair in a natural environment.There's an optional fish feet spa, the trip also included a stop at a cinnamon cooperative which was interesting. I didnt feel an obligation to buy.Overall a great view and experience. Paid 6000 for a boat for 4.
title: A wind in your hair nature experience

body: Basically an hour and a half boat ride down a river and around a lake. Ok if you're not expecting too much. There is absolutely NO wow factor. We opted out of the fish 'spa', stopped to watch an old gentleman peel cinnamon and visited one temple. Our boat was incredibly difficult for our driver to start, every time. We saw one monitor lizard and a lot of mangroves. The outing was organised by our tour company so it was a set price of RS 2,400 = AUD$20.
title: Ordinary

body: great trip went early so not to busy on the water and it was calm only problem would be if you have mobility problems as there are no steps to get into the boat or off
title: great trip

body: The experience was just about hiring a motor boat and going around 2 islands and making the tourists buy stuff or donate to the temple forcefully. There are much better things to do in Sri Lanka.
title: A tourist rip off. Can be skipped.

body: Nice walkaround in Madu Ganga (River) which has about 64 small islands. We just had a short session about 2hrs. The boat owner was a nice person. Better if you can go early in the morning to observe some birds. You can have a snack or a drink while you in the boat from the small places located in the middle of the river. You can visit and see the Cinnamon plantations and the process of making cinnamon related products during your river safari. If you interested, you can have a fish massage as well. Quite nice experience. Can recommend this place to book your river safari package.
title: Nice Experience

body: Really stunning trip across the huge Matu river. We saw loads of birds and huge bats, monkeys a water monitor lizard and to enjoy the riverscape.
title: Fab trip

body: We went there in the morning 6.30am it was the best really enjoyed lot of birds and the fish farms temple cinnamon island have good time....
title: River safari madu

body: Great day with fun guide a great trip to island of cinnamon and saw loads of wildlife on the wayA great trip amazing scenery
title: Island tour

body: At first, we read some reviews about the cruise being not worth it and got worried but i'm glad we did it! It's the best way to explore and enjoy the Sri Lanka nature and greenery. You might not see wild animals but the nature alone is breathtaking, the birds, monkeys and big lizards, the stops at the temples and Cinnamon plantation. body: This was a fantastic experience, very beautiful and saw some gorgeous birds.The cinnamon show was a lot of fun, we bought a vial of the oil which they extract. I have used it for headaches and it’s quite useful
title: madu river cruise

body: Don’t go! its disgusting and they rip you off it costs $100 !! For what?! The guy doesn’t even speak english to explain the islands. Make sure you get a good tour guide and not a person who’ll take you to his friends.The only good thing is the cinnamon island and cinnamon making.
title: The worst

body: It is a good experience to have when you are around the southern coast. It goes to a verry old Budhist temple, mangrove tour, Cinnamon Island and fish spa theropy.
title: Madu river safari

body: Was expecting a trip into the mangroves of the Madu River, but ended up on some surreal Pirates of the Caribbean boat ride. Any wildlife that once inhabited this region has long since departed due to the huge number of old fiberglass boats that buzz up and down the waterways creating nothing but noise and fumes. The only wildlife you will most likely encounter will be a juvenile water monitor placed on a log by the river where a very excited young boy will point it out as you go by, as it was clearly placed there [2 hours later the boy was still jumping up and down pointing out the reptile. Such energy, such enthusiasm.] as all the boats veered into this spot before the water monitor was even in view. A baby monkey will be thrust at you from an outrigger canoe and money demanded from its owner. Again the boats veer towards this act of exploitation. All along the river are shops on stilts selling the usual drinks and snacks at exorbitant prices. There are many opportunities for you to part with your money so take plenty. The temple on the island will expect a donation, the cinnamon stick man and feet eating fish will expect money too. All this for 50 USD plus expenses. An unnatural experience and a complete disgrace. Tourism at its abject worst.
title: Unnatural nature

body: This is a very nice activity in Maduganga, offering yet another aspect of the infinite variety of Sri Lankan nature. Birds, Water Varanus, fish, crocodile and many more. The natural habitat is well hidden from the main road and so are the various monasteries that dot the islands of the river. You can learn about the production of cinamon oil extract from locals and visit monasteries in the islands. Try to get a boat with a shade to avoid strong sun rays and have some water with you as it gets hot.
title: Interesting river activity

body: We had a great trip when we done this safari. Going through the mangroves was amazing. We were expected to do the foot massage which cost extra, but it was fun- although the fish do bite. We stopped at many of little islands and saw some temples which was lovely and our tour guide was great. We would recommend this tour!
title: Great trip

body: The boat ride was very great as you see many islands including a visit to a temple in an island.fish spa was good and reasonably priced. also they have a restaurant which they serve the best seafood in the area. you can choose your live seafood and ask them to make it the way you want.
title: Great Boat Ride

body: This is a boat tour across the islands that were rich in biodiversity, only 22 islands are left in this region after the Tsumani attacks. They took us to the small 5 cent island, followed by the Cinnamon island where they showed how the cinnamon was being extracted from plants. Then, they took us into the narrow water passages between the islands, it was very adventurous and fun indeed. After that we went to the Buddha temple, and we were lucky to see a crocodile on a rock somewhere in the middle of the river (Don't worry it's safe). At last we went to the Fish therapy area, and that was fun too. A perfect set of adventure activities worth our time! :)
title: Exciting place!

body: Local people and some asians seem to enjoy it but most europeans look very unhappy and so did we.Boats everywhere racing around. Fish ‘spa’s’ everywhere, a real toerist trap. Too much too many and the company’s and everyone involved are just looking for one thing...moneyVery sad to see what toerism can do to a place. And shockend that recent travelguides still dare to recommend this.
title: Toerist rip off with many many many boats fumes and not worth it. Bad for the enviironment.

body: Madu River is in Balpitiya, Galle District. The Madu River is very rich in biodivesity. It passes through the wet zone. Normally Rs.2500 charging for boat safari. Boat safari covering mangroves, cinnamon Island & Buddhist temple. You can buy various types of cinnamon products in cinnamon island. Most highlighted event for us in boat safari was fish therapy. Rs.200-300 price range for fish therapy for each head.
title: Boat Ride, Fish Therapy

body: We enjoyed our tour of the mangrove islands. We were lucky to have a boat just for our family. The boat had shade, but you still need sun protection.The islands were interesting, and the mangroves fun to go through. We saw prawn fishing set ups by villagers, shops in the middle of the river, temples, water lily necklace, local houses and footbridge. Cinnamon growing tour, visit to Temple and fish foot spa all available if you’re wanting to do them.We also saw lots of wild life, including water monitor lizards, cormorants, monkeys, sea eagles and more.The boat driver was friendly and informative. He kindly took photos of our family group.Well worth doing. Priced reasonably at 4500 rupees total.
title: Lovely tour of this area. Plenty to see

body: This is basically a river safari in a boat through mangroves, cinnamon Island, Buddhist temple and other small islands. The tour is totally worth it and a perfect sight tour activity. We spotted a few creatures and fishing activities.Definitely a highlight.
reviewer_location: Emirate of Dubai, United Arab Emirates
title: Must Do

body: This is a wetlands boat cruise that goes through an estuary on the Madu River (close to the highway between Colombo & Galle). It was pretty expensive (almost $100 for 4 people) for an hour cruise and a stop at a couple of islands where they grow cinnamon, etc.(they sit you down for an interesting explanation of how the cinnamon is harvested, then ask for tips and try to sell you cinnamon goods- soap, tea, etc.). It is certainly beautiful with an opportunity to see crocodiles, monitor lizards, monkeys and tons of birds. (we did not glimpse the monkeys), but I did not come away convinced it was worth $100 usd. The boat operator was just that, not really a guide, though he did point out animals if he spotted them. It has some interesting temples on different islands (one with a large buddha you could see clearly from the boat) and is a good example of a wetlands system. I would not be likely to visit again as there are far more interesting things to see & spend your $$ on in Sri Lanka.
title: Fun but not incredible; not worth the price.

body: One of the best things we've done. Shows just how beautiful tropical Sri Lanka is. We saw a few birds, but the flora and fauna were the real treats. Cinnamon Gardens showing how the cinnamon plant becomes the cinnamon spice was good. Fish treating your feet was fun. Thoroughly recommend this trip. 1500 rupees per adult for 1. 5 hours. Little kids go free
title: Jungle boat trip in Ahungalle

body: Nothing soecial about this river. I really dont see any reason for so many boats to run tours on this utterly uninteresting river. We saw 1 water monitor (which i suspect is always sitting on the same tree because the boat driver knew exactly where to look for it), a couple of kingfishers and 3 or 4 cormorants. That was it regarding wildlife. The cinnamon island visit took about 10 minutes and was a total tourist show. Not interesting at all. Temple was nothing special either. If it was on the side of the road i dont think i would bother to stop and have a look. There are numerous more beautiful and interesting temples everywhere in sri lanka. We skipped the fish spa. The lake itself is nice, but with the engine noise and smoke even the boat ride itself is not very enjoyable. Our 7 and 9 year old kids also found the whole experience quite boring.On top of that this tour is really overpriced! We had to pay 6000 lkr (40usd) for 2 adults (kids free), which is really far too much for this very mediocre experience. My advice - skip this one. There are far more interesting things to do in sri lanka.

body: Sent for this cruise in a rickety boat... did not see any birds or animals... the cinnamon island was good... else the rest was a sham. Paid LKR 8000 for two... not worth the experience.
title: Over rated

body: From a person who did both madu and bentota river, I can tell you that bentota is cheaper and better! In madu river, we didn’t see a lot of animals and birds. We saw only 3 types of birds and 1 water monitor lizard. No crocodiles (we saw only one’s head in bentota and it was like for 1-2 sec). The driver wasn’t that sharp in spotting creatures, either he depended on other boats’ captains or we spot them ourselves. Even though, bentota river was much better. Also PLEASE! Notice that your driver/ tourist agent may bring you to a place who take 30$ per person in a very large crowded boat, well, don’t buy anything! There are lots of places to do madu river, we did it for 40$- 1 hour and 30 min (almost 6200 rs) and we took the whole boat so it was only me, my family and the driver ofc. I believe you could find a cheaper price id you search more. However, they don’t serve us anything in comparison to Bentota river, where fresh fruits were given to us and included in the price (5000 rs for the whole boat for 2 hours!!). Weather we were unlucky or the driver was bad, I really advice to avoid this and go for Bentota river for your own sake. Here, it’s more commercial!
title: Overrated, go to Bentota river

body: We were a group of 12 who took a tour along this river and what a delight it was. We saw various bird species, water monitors, dragonflies and beautiful plants along the way (including Mangrove areas).we stopped off at a Buddhisttempke (set on its one small island) which was fascinating. A really enjoyable tour.
title: Exhilarating

body: We were on a tour of Sri Lanka in June as part of a Trip A Deal group tour and our guide, Lakmal, suggested we do this tour in some spare time we had. It was well worth it. A very interesting boat ride......we saw two iguanas swimming across the river and the cinnamon demonstration was enthralling. I had no idea cinnamon was harvested that way. And the foot skin nibbling fish was certainly an experience!!!Cruising through the mangroves and around the water ways was very relaxing and scenic.
title: Interesting and Well Worth It.

body: Charged us 9200 Srilankan rupees for the tour which is worth for 3500-6000srilankan rupees (I checked these reviews later😞). Felt cheated.
title: Cheating

body: If you want to see mangroves in sri lanka, this is the place you need to visit. there are many boat facilitators to take you around river islands. While you watch mangrove, you can visit temples, cinnamon works, biodiversity of the river, fish therapy and more.
title: the best place to see mangroves.

body: We enjoy the ride. Amazing view and so many ilands to watch. avoid during noon. Best time to ride is early morning or late afternoon.
title: One of the best Kadolana in Sri Lanka

body: The variety of Flora, Fauna and birds you see in this area is amazing. You take a motor boat tour of Madu river to cover this bio diverse area. A must visit for nature lovers and adventure seekers.
title: Madu Ganga Biodiversity Area: Exceptional Experience

body: Madu River Cruise is a private run venture but offers one of the finest experiences in Sri Lanka. It takes you to Cinnamon island and to deep inside wet land foliage. The prices are bargain able. Very calm and soothing experience. If in Sri Lanka Must visit.
title: Madu River: Cruise One of The Finest in Sri Lanka

body: We went with the Captains Boat ride company - the owner dresses like an old sea captain. You get a hurried explanation of the route delivered on the bored tones of someone who has already explained it hundreds of times that day. The boats are very old and look barely riverworthy. It is entirely contrived in that you get taken to 5 or 6 spots where they may be monkeys or birds. We saw very little although thats always a risk. We were promised fish therapy but the points on the islands where this was offered had closed. One of the spots is where they show you how they make cinnamon sticks but it lasts about 5 minutes and then they want you to buy products. The boat driver didn't even bother with any commentary so I am afraid he didn't get a tip. This was a waste of money - go down to Bentota and try the water sports instead
title: An uninspiring boat ride

body: The lagoon is close to Bentota area and there are quite a lot of river cruise operators offering 2-hour boat rides into the area.The lagoon houses a lot of local villages within its many islands. With its vast mangrove growth the area is a biodiversity hotspot and you will see a variety of birds, monkeys and small alligators. Try to avoid the high noon and go for early morning or late afternoon when the animal activity is more vibrant.The ride comprises of visits to a few of the islands and includes sites like cinnamon-preparation, temples and if you are interested fish spa as well. The operators are quite flexible so just let them know what you are interested to see.
title: Pleasant lagoon boat ride

body: Madu River is a awesome place to go river safari, have a fish therapy and see cinnamon cultivating and much more.there are several places where you can take a boat. and they will charge separate for the fish therapy.
title: Awsome Place to enjoy ariver boat ride

body: I cannot believe that anyone could have anything positive to say about these boat trips. I would not even give it a single dot of rating, but the system doesn’t allow it! We were told 2000rp for one & half hour, visiting an island etc. the trip,took just an hour. Visited No island! body: The Madu Ganga in Balapitiya, 80km south of Colombo, is a very special place. This Ramsar site covers 900 hectares of open water, dense mangrove forest and 64 islands. It is the second largest wetland site in Sri Lanka and one of the last pristine mangrove forests in Sri Lanka. It is home to many fish, prawns, crustaceans, crocodiles, monkeys, giant squirrels, snakes, wild boar and a variety of fishing birds. Boat trips of about 1 to 2 hours, from beside the highway, will take you into the ganga, under several very low bridges (be sure to lower your head), past prawn and crab traps, through the mangrove forest and will stop off at 2 of the islands. On the first you are shown something of cinnamon production. On the second island is Kothduwa Rajamaha Viharaya, a Buddhist temple and monastery which is like a small museum. If you are lucky you may also see some of the animal life along the way, although when we visited, there was little to see apart from some monkeys and birds. You may be able to buy crabs and prawns from the fishermen, particularly at night when they set out in canoes with kerosene lamps to attract fish, shrimps, prawns and crabs. For an additional cost you could indulge in a bout of fish therapy when hundreds of small doctor fish suck the dead skin from your legs and feet. It is a ticklish business.As with most tourist attractions in Sri Lanka, there is no shortage of boats or guides here trying to cash in on the opportunity to make some money from the tourist trade. My advice would be to check out several of these ‘boat tour companies’, inspect the boat offered and the lifejackets, the knowledge of the guide and agree the price of the trip. It is an interesting experience - at the right price. However the motorized boats that bring the tourists are an unwelcome sight for the fishermen as they damage the established fish and prawn traps and disturb the breeding areas for the shrimps and prawns. As a result, this form of fishing is becoming a dying art. It is a case of tourism benefitting some, at the expense of others.
